summary: When a server has a working IPv4 path but broken IPv6, a dual-stack client can wait a long time before falling back, hurting user experience. This RFC specifies requirements for algorithms that reduce that delay and gives one. It was replaced by RFC 8305.

eli5.summary: If one door is stuck, you do not want to wait forever before trying the other. This tells programs to try both quickly. A newer RFC 8305 replaced it.
